scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @mezan/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @mezan/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck
scripts.test: echo 'Business-logic tests are disabled (see docs/TESTING.md §1). Run `pnpm smoke` and verify in the running app instead.' && exit 0
scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm run lint:rtl && pnpm run lint:tokens && pnpm run lint:controls && pnpm run lint:permission-labels && pnpm --filter @mezan/ui lint:theme
scripts.test:e2e: echo 'E2E running is disabled (see docs/TESTING.md §1).' && exit 0
scripts.test:e2e:ui: echo 'E2E running is disabled (see docs/TESTING.md §1).' && exit 0
